concept.title: Sharing invite links
concept.shortdesc: Click Copy invite link on an interview to create an invite and copy its URL. The link opens a public, mobile-friendly chat page:

ol.li: They chat with the interviewer agent — replies stream in live.
When they're done, the session is complete.

conbody.p: Invite links are token-authenticated and can be revoked: Close an interview and its invite links stop working (you'll be asked to confirm). Closing is permanent — a closed interview can't issue new invites, so create a new interview if you need more sessions.

The interviewer agent needs a runner online to reply — automations-style ownerless routing applies, so a hosted runner keeps interviews responsive even when no one is at their desk (see Runs & runners).
